test_is_publishable_unpublished: test that is_publishable returns True when local version is older than latest but unpublished

test_parse_version: test parse_version to convert a version string like 1.3.5 into a packaging Version object

test_release_module_functions: test the release module functions including is_publishable, parse_version, and PackageInfo together
